Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but I want to make sure everyone here is aware since it's not on Mara's draft lock sheet yet.

I have not yet entered the restriction in the rights tracker, but I'm disclosing it now so it can be reflected in the final lock sheet.
